'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Scott Church DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Church]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Printed list (expanded).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
